description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

scenarios.scenario: A financial analyst has a quarterly earnings report in PDF format and needs to extract the multi-page financial tables into an Excel spreadsheet for modeling.
scenarios.user_query: Can you extract all the balance sheet and cash flow tables from Q3_Report.pdf and save them into a clean Excel file?

scenarios.scenario: An accountant received several scanned paper receipts saved as digital files where text cannot be selected or copied, and needs the text transcribed for bookkeeping.
scenarios.user_query: I have these scanned receipt scans in my folder, but I can't search or copy any text from them. Can you run optical character recognition on all pages and give me the transcribed text?

scenarios.scenario: An HR coordinator has an official interactive tax form and a JSON file with new hire details, needing to automate the form filling.
scenarios.user_query: I need to fill out the fillable fields in fw4_form.pdf using the employee data from employee_104.json. Please generate the completed file as fw4_filled.pdf.

scenarios.scenario: A legal clerk has a flat, non-interactive scanned intake form and needs text and checkmarks placed precisely onto the blank underlines.
scenarios.user_query: This onboarding questionnaire doesn't have interactive fields, just blank lines on the page image. Can you place 'Jane Doe' on the Applicant Name line and check the 'Full-time' box?

scenarios.scenario: A paralegal is preparing a trial bundle and needs to combine several individual PDF exhibits into a single master document.
scenarios.user_query: Please merge exhibit_A.pdf, exhibit_B.pdf, and exhibit_C.pdf into a single document called master_exhibits.pdf in that exact order.

scenarios.scenario: A high school teacher printed student progress reports into one massive 150-page file and needs each individual student page saved as its own file.
scenarios.user_query: I have one giant file containing 150 individual report cards. Can you split it so every single page becomes its own separate document named student_1, student_2, and so on?

scenarios.scenario: An architect received an engineering drawing bundle where several landscape pages were scanned in portrait mode and need rotation.
scenarios.user_query: Pages 3 and 7 in structural_drawings.pdf are upside down, and page 5 is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. Can you fix their orientations and save a corrected copy?

scenarios.scenario: A graphic designer needs to recover high-resolution product photos embedded inside a marketing brochure document without taking manual screenshots.
scenarios.user_query: Our agency lost the raw image files for the summer catalog. Is there a way to extract all original embedded photos directly out of summer_catalog_final at full quality?

scenarios.scenario: A healthcare administrator must secure a sensitive patient report with a password before sending it via email.
scenarios.user_query: Please encrypt patient_history.pdf with the user password 'MedSecure2024' and owner password 'AdminPass99' using AES encryption.

scenarios.scenario: A compliance officer has a password-protected vendor audit document and wants the security restrictions stripped using the known password.
scenarios.user_query: I have the password for this locked audit file—it's 'AuditSecure123'. Can you remove the encryption completely so my team doesn't have to enter the password every time they open it?

scenarios.scenario: A data scientist wants to stamp a bold 'CONFIDENTIAL' watermark across every page of an internal analytics document.
scenarios.user_query: Can you apply watermark.pdf diagonally across all pages of quarterly_insights.pdf and export the result as confidential_insights.pdf?

scenarios.scenario: A sales operations lead has a JSON payload of invoice line items and needs a professional, styled two-page customer invoice document generated from scratch.
scenarios.user_query: I need to generate a polished customer invoice from this order JSON data, complete with our company header, an itemized pricing table with alternating row colors, and a grand total footer.

scenarios.scenario: A chemical engineer writing a technical documentation script using ReportLab needs chemical formulas rendered properly with subscripts instead of black boxes.
scenarios.user_query: I'm generating a chemistry report PDF in ReportLab, but H₂O and CO₂ are showing up as black rectangular glyph errors. How do I fix the XML markup tags for subscript formulas in Paragraph objects?

scenarios.scenario: An archivist has digitized historical records that are currently just image scans and wants to make them full-text searchable by researchers.
scenarios.user_query: We have 40 pages of digitized 19th-century council minutes that are purely pictures right now. We need the text detected and embedded under the images so visitors can search keywords in their viewer.

scenarios.scenario: A web developer is preparing a heavy 80MB document for web download and wants it linearized so users can view page 1 immediately while the rest loads.
scenarios.user_query: Can you optimize and linearize whitepaper_v2.pdf for fast web view streaming using qpdf, and compress any redundant objects?

scenarios.scenario: An operations manager downloaded a corrupted monthly transaction summary that fails to open in standard document viewers.
scenarios.user_query: Our monthly ledger export file seems damaged—whenever anyone tries opening it, the reader throws a structural syntax error. Can you check and repair its internal structure?

scenarios.scenario: A university student wants to extract text from a multi-column lecture syllabus while strictly preserving its original columnar visual layout.
scenarios.user_query: Run pdftotext with layout preservation on syllabus_advanced_econ.pdf and output the text to syllabus_layout.txt.

scenarios.scenario: A real estate agent noticed a scanned closing agreement has wide scanner borders and black feed marks along the margins that need trimming.
scenarios.user_query: This signed closing agreement has huge 1.5-inch black scanner feed borders around every page. Can you crop 50 points off the top, bottom, and sides across all pages?

scenarios.scenario: A software engineer working in Node.js needs to selectively extract pages 1, 3, and 5 from one agreement and append them to another contract.
scenarios.user_query: Using pdf-lib in JavaScript, how do I load agreement_A.pdf and agreement_B.pdf, extract pages 0, 2, and 4 from B, and append them into A before saving?

scenarios.scenario: A talent recruiter has 50 applicant resumes in a directory and needs all the plain text dumped into corresponding text files for keyword scanning.
scenarios.user_query: I have a folder with fifty job application files. Can you loop through all of them, extract the complete text content from each one, and save matching .txt files in the output directory?

scenarios.scenario: An event coordinator wants to inspect a newly created event registration form to discover the exact names and types of all interactive fields.
scenarios.user_query: Can you run a check on conference_registration.pdf to see if it has fillable form fields, and output the field IDs and bounding boxes to a JSON file?

scenarios.scenario: A logistics coordinator received shipment manifests where tables have complex overlapping cell borders and wants the tabular data parsed accurately.
scenarios.user_query: Here is today's cargo manifest document. The tables have weird borders, but I need the tracking numbers, container weights, and destination ports cleanly parsed into a structured list.

scenarios.scenario: A security analyst is investigating a suspicious document and needs to inspect its creator, producer, creation date, and embedded metadata.
scenarios.user_query: Please extract all document metadata (Title, Author, Creator, Producer, CreationDate) from suspicious_invoice.pdf using pypdf.

scenarios.scenario: A clinical research associate needs to extract only the methodology chapter (pages 45 through 68) from a 300-page trial dossier.
scenarios.user_query: I only need pages 45 to 68 from our 300-page trial dossier. Can you pull out just that range and save it as methodology_section?

scenarios.scenario: An office assistant has a flat PDF application form and needs to extract its structural lines, text labels, and checkboxes to prepare an annotation overlay.
scenarios.user_query: Please run extract_form_structure.py on vendor_app_flat.pdf to generate form_structure.json so we can map out coordinates for filling it.

scenarios.scenario: A marketing manager needs high-resolution image snapshots of each slide from a 12-page presentation deck for a social media carousel.
scenarios.user_query: I need every slide in presentation_deck rendered as a 300 DPI PNG image file so we can upload them directly to our marketing blog.

scenarios.scenario: A billing manager wants to restrict an invoice template so recipients can view it but cannot modify content or print it.
scenarios.user_query: Can you use qpdf to encrypt client_invoice_template.pdf with 256-bit encryption, setting print permissions to none and modify permissions to none?

scenarios.scenario: A journal editor needs to collate two separate drafts, taking the odd pages from version 1 and interleaving them with the even pages from version 2.
scenarios.user_query: I have two drafts of the manuscript. I need to construct a new document by taking pages 1, 3, and 5 from draft_A and inserting pages 2, 4, and 6 from draft_B between them.

scenarios.scenario: A legal assistant extracted coordinates from a PDF form and wants to validate that the bounding boxes don't collide before running the annotation script.
scenarios.user_query: I just drafted fields.json for the affidavit form. Can you run check_bounding_boxes.py on it to ensure there are no overlapping boxes or undersized fonts before we fill it?

scenarios.scenario: A restaurant owner has a structured list of daily specials and wants a clean, formatted single-sheet menu layout ready for printing.
scenarios.user_query: Here is our weekend brunch menu data with categories, item descriptions, and prices. Can you generate a printable 8.5x11 document with custom typography, clean dividers, and centered headers?
